svg.aria-label: Kavidu Purnamal - a software engineering student, with a floating astronaut, a friendly alien, planets and a rocket

g.text: Hi, I'm Kavidu, a software engineering student at SLIIT in Sri Lanka.
I love building websites, mobile apps, and games that are simple to use
and nice to look at. I'm always learning something new, and I'm excited
to turn my ideas into real projects that help people.
